quirks.summary: The appRef filter needs the zero-padded 5-digit serial; the unpadded form returns zero hits rather than an error.
quirks.detail: MO/2026/01108 matches. MO/2026/1108 gets 0 hits, which is indistinguishable from the application not existing.
quirks.workaround: Zero-pad the serial to five digits before searching.
